WITH sma_10003_cte AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) AS metric_time__day
    , channel AS order__channel
    , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN paid_cents - refund_cents ELSE 0 END AS __net_sales_cents
    , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents > refund_cents THEN member_id ELSE NULL END AS __buyer_count
  FROM "data"."main"."orders" orders_source_src_10000
)

SELECT
  COALESCE(subq_8.order__channel, subq_14.order__channel) AS order__channel
  , MAX(subq_8.buyer_count) AS buyer_count
  , MAX(CAST(subq_14.net_sales_cents AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(subq_14.buyer_count, 0) AS DOUBLE)) AS avg_buyer_value
FROM (
  SELECT
    order__channel
    , COUNT(DISTINCT __buyer_count) AS buyer_count
  FROM sma_10003_cte
  WHERE metric_time__day BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
  GROUP BY
    order__channel
) subq_8
FULL OUTER JOIN (
  SELECT
    order__channel
    , SUM(__net_sales_cents) AS net_sales_cents
    , COUNT(DISTINCT __buyer_count) AS buyer_count
  FROM sma_10003_cte
  WHERE metric_time__day BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
  GROUP BY
    order__channel
) subq_14
ON
  subq_8.order__channel = subq_14.order__channel
GROUP BY
  COALESCE(subq_8.order__channel, subq_14.order__channel)
